test_title: SSC MTS Previous Year Paper (Held on: 19 July 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: In a certain code language, 'WORLD' is written as 'CUXRJ' and 'SMOKE' is written as ‘YSUQK’. How will 'INDIA' be written in that language?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9b1ef5af07dc7cdface0347994bbc6f824cbda2bac27bcab0cb4cf07968dfa00.png] 

The logic followed here is: **Letter + 6**.

For, 'WORLD' is written as 'CUXRJ',

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/3cc343b5fcbc210548049374ccfdc61c8261b206e44b2a35036ebf375185ddf4.png] 

For, 'SMOKE' is written as ‘YSUQK’,

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c3b045e8dd42a949315604e09e980bfefac794f26e9812b5450c19c3f5259cf8.png] 

Similarly, for 'INDIA'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/51a82c5b410b7e5bb25a5034864317cf9c496593a70a816bfb037c63dfd9b734.png] 

So, 'INDIA' will be written as 'OTJOG'.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 3".
